decisions.summary: Keep tofloat(String) as 64-bit in the Rust engine instead of copying C's strtof.
decisions.rationale: This issue was fixed by the Rust engine, and this decision records it as deliberate to prevent diverging back toward C.

decisions.summary: Mark nested unit CALL {} subqueries not capping cardinality as a critical issue.
decisions.rationale: Unit subqueries must emit exactly one row per input row, but nested ones leak inner fan-out into the outer row count on the Rust engine.

decisions.summary: Mark OPTIONAL MATCH binding an already-bound node path to NULL as a critical regression.
decisions.rationale: Reusing an already-bound node in an OPTIONAL MATCH path pattern binds the path to NULL or leaves it unbound on the Rust engine instead of a singleton path.

decisions.summary: Close the issue as a duplicate of another issue.
decisions.rationale: Duplicate of #2716, which describes the same defect and predates this by several days.

decisions.summary: Bump cargo-fuzz to version 0.13.2 to fix compilation failures on current nightly rustc.
decisions.rationale: Cargo-fuzz 0.13.1 resolves rustix v0.36.5 which uses reserved rustc compiler attributes rejected by current nightly, whereas 0.13.2 resolves rustix v1.1.4 and builds clean.

decisions.summary: Make IdSpace own live counts, recycled sets, entry bounds, and taken sets as fields on Graph.
decisions.rationale: An IdSpace that is passed the state it owns is a validator with extra steps, and the wrappers around Graph's members were moving logic between files rather than giving the ids an owner.

decisions.summary: Agreed to fix string.replaceRegEx to copy replacements literally rather than expanding $-references.
decisions.rationale: The X is a literal the user wrote, and the expansion silently deletes it. That is a data change on text that never contained a capture group.

decisions.summary: Keep exact integer division in Rust and handle the i64::MIN / -1 overflow case explicitly.
decisions.rationale: Converting integer operands to f64 before division would reproduce current C behavior, but it can lose precision for large integers, produce incorrect quotients, and break the expected relationship between division and modulo.

decisions.summary: Follow openCypher equality for UNIQUE constraints rather than reproducing C's Boolean-to-numeric conflation.
decisions.rationale: After reviewing the reported behavior, I agree with the recommendation to follow openCypher equality rather than reproduce the current C implementation's Boolean-to-numeric conflation.

decisions.summary: Sort union type members using canonical type order and fix db.idx.fulltext.drop error message to avoid empty parentheses.
decisions.rationale: I can start with the two formatting fixes: Sort union type members using the canonical type order so the output matches C, and fix the db.idx.fulltext.drop error message to avoid empty parentheses when no attribute is specified.

decisions.summary: Replaced the deprecated architectures key with the platforms key format in snapcraft.yaml for core24 base.
decisions.rationale: The 'architectures' key is not supported for base 'core24' and requires using the 'platforms' key instead.

decisions.summary: Moved snap configuration and files under the build directory.
decisions.rationale: Requested by maintainer to organize new snap files under the build folder.

decisions.summary: Replaced snapcore/action-build with direct snapcraft installation using destructive mode.
decisions.rationale: Directly building in the runner environment avoids container device permission issues like /dev/null and /dev/urandom errors.

decisions.summary: Allocate attributes during node reservation instead of handling null attributes defensively.
decisions.rationale: Ensuring attributes are always allocated during node reservation (in Graph_ReserveNode and Graph_CreateNode) eliminates the possibility of NULL attributes entirely, making the defensive checks unnecessary.

decisions.summary: Use a function pointer for distance scoring instead of sim_func.
decisions.rationale: replace sim_func with a function pointer

decisions.summary: Trim the trailing slash from the path in the custom temporary folder configuration logic.
decisions.rationale: I followed the same logic as the Config_import_folder_set function, adding only the logic to trim the trailing "/"

decisions.summary: Always send keyspace notifications to allow other modules to subscribe even if client notifications are disabled.
decisions.rationale: We would like to notify other module even if the clients didn't enable the notifications.

decisions.summary: Notify graph.deleted after the delete operation completes.
decisions.rationale: Consistent with how graph.modified is sent after the modification completes.

decisions.summary: Gate the destination-name override to the single-key restore path (`key_number == 1`).
decisions.rationale: Gated destination-name override to key_number == 1 so multi-key virtual key decodes continue using the embedded graph_name.

decisions.summary: Rewrite serializer boundary tests to remove fragile byte-size assumptions and VKEY_MAX_ENTITY_COUNT overrides.
decisions.rationale: Relying on entity counts to translate into specific byte sizes is too fragile and subject to change under GraphBLAS.

decisions.summary: Protect writer queries with a graph READ lock during their match phase to prevent concurrency races.
decisions.rationale: Prevents entity pointers from being invalidated mid-execution by concurrent memory modifications during active defrag or GRAPH.EFFECT.

decisions.summary: Abort immediately on corrupted or misaligned RDB buffers during deleted-entity decoding using RedisModule_Log and RedisModule_Assert.
decisions.rationale: Prevents use-after-free and double-free when buffers are misaligned or counts do not match, replacing silent returns.

decisions.summary: Add custom Reset callbacks for OpMerge and OpMergeCreate operators to properly support CALL subqueries with multiple outer bindings.
decisions.rationale: Without a reset callback, subsequent outer rows drop output or reuse stale handoff/creation states incorrectly.

decisions.summary: Split testConstraintNodes into 7 focused test classes and extract module-level helpers.
decisions.rationale: Prevents test timeouts and eliminates duplicated populate_graph and create_constraints implementations across node-constraint classes.

decisions.summary: Implement tomap_projection to return null when map projection is performed on a null entity.
decisions.rationale: Per openCypher, a map projection on a null entity should evaluate to null rather than producing a map of null values.

decisions.summary: Return an explicit parameter parsing error and bail out early in ExecutionCtx_FromQuery when parameter parsing fails.
decisions.rationale: Prevents leaving the query buffer corrupted with embedded null bytes from partial parameter name processing, which caused cryptic Cypher parse errors.

decisions.summary: Synchronize both jobqueue length and capacity accesses using the existing rwmutex in the thread pool implementation.
decisions.rationale: Reading len under lock while reading cap unsafely can produce inconsistent fullness decisions under concurrent cap updates, so both must be guarded.

decisions.summary: Keep the self-reference check local as src == dest instead of extracting it to a separate helper function.
decisions.rationale: I don't think you should export this to a function.

decisions.summary: Introduce a new function in arr.h to return the array size in bytes without exposing arr_hdr.
decisions.rationale: introduce a new function to arr.h which will give back the size in bytes of the array, there's no need to use arr_hdr that should remain internal to arr.h as much as possible.

decisions.summary: Define a new range iterator struct and helper functions in util/range_iter.h/c.
decisions.rationale: I think a new struct need to be defined within the util folder e.g. util/range_iter.h/c, this struct should replace these new fields.

decisions.summary: Handle the conversion of the range function into an iterator as part of the unwind operator.
decisions.rationale: I think we should change the range function to be non reducible and handle the conversion of it into an iterator as part of the unwind op.

decisions.summary: Use the FalkorDB license header for new files.
decisions.rationale: for new files, use the FalkorDB license

decisions.summary: Run GraphLoadQueue_Free() after ThreadPool_Destroy() during shutdown to prevent concurrent access races.
decisions.rationale: GraphLoadQueue_Free() is explicitly not thread-safe with concurrent AcquireOrWait/Drain, so it must run only after worker threads are stopped.

decisions.summary: Refuse queries with duplicate property keys in inline property maps with a validation error.
decisions.rationale: Changing semantics for duplicate inlined property keys fixes a server crash by rejecting duplicate inline keys at validation time.

decisions.summary: Require every PR to close an issue via GitHub workflow checking closingIssuesReferences.
decisions.rationale: Adds a check requiring every PR to close an issue without exemptions, ensuring all changes are tracked to an issue.

decisions.summary: We are not required to hold the GIL when calling the reply API.
decisions.rationale: we're not required to hold the GIL when calling the reply API

decisions.summary: Pair each regression query with its expected undefined variable in test assertions rather than matching generic strings.
decisions.rationale: Agreed that checking only for not defined was too loose and could pass on unrelated errors, so each query is now paired with the specific variable the binder must reject.

decisions.summary: Wrap the fixed test graph in a try-finally block with g.delete() for cleanup.
decisions.rationale: This test uses its own graph key rather than the module-level GRAPH_ID, so a retried run would accumulate duplicate data; wrapping in try/finally with g.delete() prevents this.

decisions.summary: Re-assert positive counts, retained writes, and test mutation isolation after DEBUG RELOAD.
decisions.rationale: The post-reload block only asserted negatives so dropped nodes would pass, and no mutations were performed afterward; adding positive checks and post-reload writes ensures safety.

decisions.summary: Make lowering consuming so inline property map predicates are planned once rather than twice and stripped from patterns.
decisions.rationale: MATCH (a {p: 1}) was surface syntax lowered to an IR::Filter while also left on the QueryNode/QueryRelationship embedded in the plan, causing duplicate predicates.

decisions.summary: Remove edge_filter from the IR and use parent_filters_edge to obtain it.
decisions.rationale: edge_predicate looked redundant and parent_filters_edge provides the necessary derivation.

decisions.summary: Model the parser grammar to allow one unary sign plus an optional second sign on numeric literals.
decisions.rationale: Neo4j not allowing more than 2 unary operators this can lead to allow too users to provide too long query

decisions.summary: Use pos() and set_pos() to peek and rewind instead of cloning for lookahead.
decisions.rationale: optional_match_token consumes before we can see the next token, and -9223372036854775808 only fits with its sign attached.

decisions.summary: Catch only ResponseError in regression tests validating rejected Cypher queries.
decisions.rationale: Catching only ResponseError verifies the expected query error. It does not hide unrelated failures such as assertion errors or connection errors.

decisions.summary: Align continuation indentation of the final liveness check in test18_path_filter_under_non_decomposable_operator by assigning the query to a local first.
decisions.rationale: The continuation indentation was inconsistent with the surrounding style, so assigning the query to a local variable first makes it cleaner and matches the style.

decisions.summary: Treat OrApplyMultiplexer as existence-only in traverse fusion to preserve path multiplicity.
decisions.rationale: Branch rows are discarded under OrApplyMultiplexer so path multiplicity is unobservable there for the same reason it is under SemiApply.

decisions.summary: Copy profiles from stopped service containers rather than workspace bind mounts to capture flow coverage.
decisions.rationale: Services start before actions/checkout, and checkout removes untracked mount sources under github.workspace.

decisions.summary: Move the edge-storage boundary harness PR into #2433 so it ships alongside the paper.
decisions.rationale: The harness is an artifact of the paper, not an independent change to main, and is only useful alongside the text that cites it.

decisions.summary: Move the #2430 reproduction benches into #2433 instead of merging them independently.
decisions.rationale: The two reproductions are paper artifacts and part of §evalboundary's argument, so they belong with the paper branch #2433.

decisions.summary: Git owns the submodule directly and redisearch.sh no longer touches git.
decisions.rationale: Both of your points landed on the same thing, so I did it properly rather than defending the old shape.

decisions.summary: Merge the two constructors into a single create_lagraph_graph function with a borrowed parameter.
decisions.rationale: The two bodies were the same fifteen lines twice over, differing in a single branch: whether the failure path frees the matrix.

decisions.summary: Use RoaringTreemap::insert_range instead of collecting ranges into a temporary set for NodeIdSpace range insertions.
decisions.rationale: insert_range avoids per-id insertion plus the extra allocation, drastically speeding up processing (e.g. from 7.87s down to 432us for large ranges).

decisions.summary: Refuse u64::MAX bound overflows in NodeIdSpace with a checked add returning an ApplyError::NodeIdOutOfRange.
decisions.rationale: A wrapped bound is worse than a panic here: at 0 every later check reads as free, so the rest of the buffer would be waved through incorrectly.

decisions.summary: Introduce a dedicated limit_zero construction flag in LimitOp to handle LIMIT 0 by returning an empty batch without consuming extra child batches.
decisions.rationale: Branching purely on remaining == 0 also catches exhausted positive limits, which can cause positive limits to pull an extra child batch. A dedicated flag ensures zero-limit behaves correctly without unintended extra pulls.

decisions.summary: Make record_cap a required constructor argument for BatchedResultEmitter.
decisions.rationale: Construct-then-apply made no cap the silent default where five ops remembered to pass the budget, whereas making it an argument becomes a compile error.

decisions.summary: Close the PR as a duplicate of an existing earlier pull request.
decisions.rationale: I found this independently by profiling and did not check for existing work on the same operator first — that was my mistake, and #2693 should be the one that lands.

decisions.summary: Close the PR and reject inferring an unlabelled point lookup index scan from graph contents.
decisions.rationale: FalkorDB's indexes are label-scoped by design, and a query that wants an index should name the label. Inferring one from the data made the plan depend on graph contents rather than the schema.

decisions.summary: Switch from DegreeIndex::created_endpoints to CreatedRel struct carrying type name, from, and to fields.
decisions.rationale: Widening the map alone made things worse and caused a larger RSS footprint, necessitating a direct storage struct rather than separate endpoint maps.

decisions.summary: Batch GrB matrix operations by collecting dead and checked pairs into shared coordinate vectors using Matrix::build.
decisions.rationale: Per-pair FFI calls can be very costly for mass detach deletes, so Matrix::build should be used as a single bulk FFI call.

decisions.summary: Admission uses one global counter in place of pending_count to bound every queued query including writes.
decisions.rationale: Workers remove a job from that queue before adding its WriteMessage, so a slow graph can accumulate an unbounded per-graph backlog while new commands continue to pass admission; the new channel can therefore grow memory and blocked-client state without the configured pending-query cap applying.

decisions.summary: Throttling incoming queries with an error once max pending queries is reached instead of increasing the queue to unbounded size.
decisions.rationale: At or over MAX_QUEUED_QUERIES, the incoming query is rejected immediately with C's exact error, Max pending queries.

decisions.summary: Make the hash join follow equals semantics and match C behavior by aligning Int and Float comparisons.
decisions.rationale: A rewrite must not change the result, so the join follows equals and matches C.

decisions.summary: Dedupe relTypes in algo.SPpaths/SSpaths config at the parse boundary
decisions.rationale: relTypes is a set everywhere else it is read, and duplicating relation types causes duplicated paths and redundant edge scanning.

decisions.summary: Set COMPARED_NAN in SIValue_Compare when any of the four coordinates is NaN.
decisions.rationale: AR_TOPOINT only rejects out-of-range values, and NaN passes every range comparison, so a NaN coordinate reached the comparison and the point compared equal to itself.

decisions.summary: Avoid qsort when map keys are already in order by using _sort_pairs.
decisions.rationale: Re-sorting a sorted array leaves the same bytes, so skipping qsort when keys are already in order avoids unnecessary mutation side-effects and costs.

decisions.summary: Fail the artifact build when ldd -r reports a missing dependency or undefined symbol.
decisions.rationale: The check now fails on not found as well. undefined symbol already caught a missing library whose symbols the module uses; a NEEDED library it takes no symbols from printed only => not found and passed, though dlopen still refuses the module.

decisions.summary: Keep image independent of the artifacts job so images can be built without holding up the .so build.
decisions.rationale: Keeping image independent of the artifacts, as on main, where image and artifacts both need only [guard, create-release]. The Release exists before either job runs, so this gate would not prevent a partial release; it would hold the images on the .so build.

decisions.summary: Include Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, build scripts, and .cargo/config.toml to trigger artifact builds on relevant changes.
decisions.rationale: The Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, the build scripts and .cargo/config.toml now trigger the build, since that is how native code (zstd-sys, rquickjs-sys) and link flags reach the per-OS cells.

decisions.summary: Read the release list immediately before push in the retag step instead of using an earlier job's decision.
decisions.rationale: the retag step reads the release list itself, immediately before the push, instead of acting on a decision create-release made a job earlier. main had the same gap, between release-image.yml's prepare and retag jobs.

decisions.summary: Check unique constraints using the supporting index instead of a full label scan per entity.
decisions.rationale: Pending::check_node_constraint / check_edge_constraint rebuilt a hash of every key in the label once per written entity, so a commit cost O(written x label size).

decisions.summary: Make unique check function generic over node and relationship ID types.
decisions.rationale: unique_violated is now generic over the id type (Id: Copy + Into<u64>): the node check passes NodeId, the edge check RelationshipId.

decisions.summary: Allow NUL-containing strings to use the indexed lookup path for uniqueness enforcement.
decisions.rationale: Strings with NUL matched correctly through node by index scan, and _ is escaped so they don't collide.

decisions.summary: Drop Paren wrappers in the binder so parenthesized WHERE clauses utilize index and ID lookups.
decisions.rationale: The optimizer passes match on the filter root and on the children of a top-level And, so a Paren hid the predicate from all of them.

decisions.summary: Share AND and OR expression flattening in a single helper in parser/ast.rs.
decisions.rationale: The same AND-from-a-list construction showed up 12 times after binding, so flattening now lives in one shared helper.
